documented_probe: C-03964901 (keep the serialized model within a tight size budget): this task is the covering exercise at hard difficulty; the verifier byte-audits the entire /app/model directory against the 102400-byte ceiling and runs the loader on hidden calibration sets, so optimizer state, checkpoints, or float64 duplicates blow the gate.
notes: Model-quality-vs-byte-budget tension: a 24-160-80-1 ReLU net trains to RMSE ~0.3 with plain numpy Adam, and its float32 weights (~67 KB) fit the 100 KB gate only if the artifact stores exactly the inference path — any optimizer moments, checkpoints, or float64 copies exceed it. The RMSE gate (0.45) sits between the best linear model (~0.52-0.60) and a genuine nonlinear fit, so the model must really be trained. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (architecture/training under a hard constraint), resource_pressure (the byte budget is the core difficulty), hidden_case_generalization (two hidden calibration sets, one with a 5% channel rescale), quantitative_correctness (RMSE threshold).
